name: orderflow
description: Monorepo do OrderFlow com backend Fastify, frontend React/Vite e MariaDB.

scripts.dev: sh -c 'npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend & wait'
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend/app
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run prisma:generate
